findings.summary: Approval is capped at 24h and bounds release/delegation; REFRESH and READMIT both need an unexpired approval, and expiry denies the Node with 'a new protected approval is an explicit external authority boundary'. No lane, writer semantics, phase row or fixture says whether re-approving the SAME frozen config is per-Node (no fresh proofs from unrelated members) or a whole-cohort fresh activation. If it is the latter, one offline unrelated worker blocks every Node at each 24h boundary, which is the ADR100 coupling R3 removed for leases. Root R3 required approval expiry/refresh writers and phase rows to be explicit.

findings.summary: The bootstrap circularity is broken in prose: ARM before commit grants no business, the use key is delivered only after the activation commit, and eligibility needs the delivery receipt. But the objects those gates depend on are not contracts. There is no schema for the key-delivery/possession receipt (what proves possession; binding to ledger ID/release hash/use-key hash/issuer service identity); no schema/table/writer/grant for the gate ARM acknowledgements that fresh activation waits on; no ObservationScope result schema (incl. AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE). The keyHierarchy omits ARM_EXACT_RELEASE from the release anchor's signing purposes, although the History/schema say ARM is release-authority signed. The gateControl/safety/observeInput/signedEnvelope/roleConfig schemas have zero positive or negative fixtures, and the chain model has no gate-state or delivery-receipt input, so invalidated-gate, restart-no-gate and receipt-mismatch cases are untested.
findings.revision: Add closed schemas for keyDeliveryReceipt (with a proof-of-possession signature domain over a protected challenge), gateAck and observationScope; name the ARM-ack table/writer/EXECUTE; list ARM in keyHierarchy; add fixtures: ARM signed by use/safety key denied, invalidated or absent gate denies an otherwise valid chain, restart has no gate, receipt with wrong hash/issuer/ledger denied, delivery before the activation commit denied, ObservationScope cannot yield ChannelProof/admission.
